quests.title: Custom Gift Envelope No. 6

dialogue.sit: Are you... here for a case?
You... don't look like you're here for work?

dialogue.t: I'm being forced to take a vacation.
The Maison Gardiennage stipulates that all employees are required to use our vacation time by the end of the year.
The end-of-year calculations came through, and the Patrol found out I hadn't taken a single day off, so...

dialogue.sit: Is it like that for everyone?

dialogue.t: No. Our officers operate on a rotating schedule, but as the captain of the squad, I'm always on duty.
I also deal with a lot of emergency cases, so over time, I just... forgot to take vacation.
I was fine going without any time off this year, but my officers wouldn't hear of it...
They started shouting about how "rules are meant to be followed" and "a captain needs to lead by example." Basically, they wouldn't take no for an answer.
One of the Gestionnaires who works with us mentioned how Liyue is a top vacation destination during the Lantern Rite festival. He pulled out a boat ticket right then and there, so... Here I am.
And I have to hand it to him — Liyue is a sight to behold this time of year. I just came back from Qiaoying Village, actually. I really loved the dim sum made with tea.
I bought some to share with the Special Patrol. I was planning to follow local customs and make a few gift envelopes, as well.
It's just... I'm not very good at this kind of thing. No matter what I do, it always ends up looking weird.
Do you know how to make them, {NICKNAME}?
Do you know how to make them, {NICKNAME}?
Wow, this turned out great! Hmm... you deserve something in return.
Here, take some of this dim sum as thanks for your help. Receiving this envelope from you really makes this trip worthwhile.
...Still, I've been away for some time, now. I wonder if my officers are keeping up with their training.
Well, I guess it's time to start planning a fitness test.

quests.description: Someone seems interested in creating a Gift Envelope…
